style_rules: Production delivery is DATA-FIRST DETERMINISTIC: canonical attendance data is rendered by the strict renderer; ChatGPT Image must not typeset attendance names, times, KPIs, durations, totals, or statuses.
Priority order: exact data > report-scope isolation > phone readability > visual polish > layout rigidity.
The validated AI visual request remains the canonical display contract and art-direction manifest; it is not a free-form ImageGen instruction for production data.
Render one mobile-first portrait PNG at 1080x1800 using deterministic Chromium/HTML rendering from the validated request.
Use large readable typography, 2x2 KPI cards, a clear confirmed-hours summary strip, and eight vertically stacked employee cards.
Use fresh bright green, white/light neutrals, deep navy/professional blue, restrained gold, and red/orange only for missing or attention states.
No logo, no company-name mark, no tagline, no slogan, no motivational quote, no invented decorative text.
Morning scope must never include the full-day report; full-day scope must never include the morning-only report; never render a second report/page.
Do not calculate, infer, correct, round, reinterpret or fabricate attendance data inside the renderer.
Missing values display exactly as an em dash.
Show all 8 employees exactly once, in source order, with canonical Vietnamese spelling.
Morning detail fields: Họ và tên | Trạng thái | Giờ vào | Giờ ra | Thời lượng | Mức công.
Full-day detail fields: Họ và tên | Ca sáng | Ca chiều | Tổng công | Trạng thái.
Fail closed on data mismatch, stale source, overflow, wrong dimensions, wrong employee count, or wrong canonical spelling.
ChatGPT Image may be used only for optional text-free decorative artwork outside the attendance data layer; such artwork is never authoritative and must not alter the data layout.
